text: 1944 removes prettyFolderName, a local display-string formatter; 1950 removes updateElementWithKeys, a prefstring substitution helper. Current updateBlockedItems still reads literal prefstring for locked preferences, and restorePage still attaches identity/server keys to elements. Do not infer that all prefstring use or account-specific element keys were removed with these helpers. The current junk-target validity routines remain in amUtils; no replacement display formatter is established here. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Removed account-settings helpers do not remove remaining preference and folder contracts
